extension_name.description: Name of the extension shown in the browser UI.

extension_description.message: Capture full-page screenshots of any web page. Export as PNG or PDF locally, or send to a self-hosted backend for OCR and AI analysis.
extension_description.description: Description shown in the Chrome Web Store and chrome://extensions.

popup_progress_label.description: Heading shown while capture is in progress.

popup_progress_help.message: The finished image will open in a new tab. Please leave this window in focus until the bar finishes.
popup_progress_help.description: Help text under the progress bar.

popup_split_warning.message: This page is too large for a single image. It will be saved as $count$ images.
popup_split_warning.description: Warning shown when the screenshot is split across multiple canvases.

popup_invalid_url.message: Full Page Voiceido cannot run on this URL. Try a regular http(s) page or a file:// URL.

popup_generic_error.message: Something went wrong while capturing the page. Reload the tab, ensure JavaScript is enabled, and try again.

popup_done_label.description: Status shown when capture finishes successfully.
